answer: A tide channel licenses only one flag key on the outer reef this watch. The key escrows 57 units, draws pier P=H(key||watch) mod 79, and hangs a unique raven pennant after posting H(pennant||span||key). From minute (hash mod 15)+7 it has 14 minutes to flash a 3.6 Hz bridge lamp that two keepers 31 m apart must both log. Peers attest only if the serial is unused, the span stays within 0.4 m, and the commit opens. A missed window, reused pennant, or one-keeper log burns 19 units and benches the key 8 epochs; a keeper signing two piers in one watch is fined 74 units and sits out 11 epochs.
